query: How do I report bribery demands by a government hospital staff?
reference_answer:
Reporting Bribery Demands:
To report bribery demands by a government hospital staff, contact the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department (DVAC) or the local police station. You can also call the toll-free helpline 1064 or file a complaint online on the TN Government website.
answer: To report bribery demands by a government hospital staff, contact your local anti-corruption office or police immediately. Follow up with the hospital's internal complaints system if available. [Document 1]
